title: Companies (Amendment) Act
long_title: AN ACT TO AMEND THE COMPANIES ACT, NO. 07 OF 2007

edition.caveat: read from the Government Printer PDF

operations.note: paragraphs (b) and (c) repealed; new (b), (c) and (d) (with (i)-(iii)) substituted

quality_flags.detail: Sections 3 and 4 of this Act amend sections 9 and 10 of the principal enactment (the Companies Act, No. 07 of 2007). validate_finalized_trees.py reads 'Section 9 of the principal enactment' and 'Section 10 of the principal enactment' as internal references beyond this Act's last section (5); they are references into the Companies Act, recorded as such in cross_references.

body.raw_text: 1. This Act may be cited as the Companies (Amendment) Act, No. 13 of 2019.
body.text: This Act may be cited as the Companies (Amendment) Act, No. 13 of 2019.
body.heading: Short title.

body.raw_text: 2. Section 5 of the Companies Act, No. 07 of 2007 (hereinafter referred to as the “principal enactment”) is hereby amended in subsection (1) by the repeal of paragraphs (b) and (c) thereof and the substitution therefor, of the following:-
body.text: Section 5 of the Companies Act, No. 07 of 2007 (hereinafter referred to as the “principal enactment”) is hereby amended in subsection (1) by the repeal of paragraphs (b) and (c) thereof and the substitution therefor, of the following:-

cross_references.verbatim: Section 5 of the Companies Act, No. 07 of 2007

children.raw_text: “(b) assign a unique number to that company as its company number;
children.text: assign a unique number to that company as its company number;

children.raw_text: (c) issue a certificate of incorporation in the prescribed form to the applicant company; and
children.text: issue a certificate of incorporation in the prescribed form to the applicant company; and

children.raw_text: (d) notify the general public, within sixty working days of the incorporation of a company, by a notice published in a daily newspaper which has circulation in Sinhala, English and Tamil languages which shall specify –
children.text: notify the general public, within sixty working days of the incorporation of a company, by a notice published in a daily newspaper which has circulation in Sinhala, English and Tamil languages which shall specify –

children.raw_text: (iii) the address of the registered office of the company.”.
children.text: the address of the registered office of the company.

body.heading: Amendment of section 5 of Act, No. 07 of 2007.

operations.note: paragraphs (b) and (c) repealed; new (b), (c) and (d) (with (i)-(iii)) substituted

body.raw_text: 3. Section 9 of the principal enactment is hereby amended as follows:-
body.text: Section 9 of the principal enactment is hereby amended as follows:-

children.raw_text: (1) by the repeal of subsection (1) thereof; and
children.text: by the repeal of subsection (1) thereof; and

children.raw_text: (2) in subsection (3) thereof, by the substitution for the words “subsection (1) or (2)” of the words, “subsection (2)”.
children.text: in subsection (3) thereof, by the substitution for the words “subsection (1) or (2)” of the words, “subsection (2)”.

body.heading: Amendment of section 9 of the principal enactment.

body.raw_text: 4. Section 10 of the principal enactment is hereby amended by the repeal of paragraph (b) of subsection (1) thereof, and the substitution therefor, of the following paragraph:-
body.text: Section 10 of the principal enactment is hereby amended by the repeal of paragraph (b) of subsection (1) thereof, and the substitution therefor, of the following paragraph:-

children.raw_text: “(b) a request is made to the Registrar to do so within three months of public notice of the name being given under section 5 (1) (d) and section 9 (2) by another company or by a registered overseas company, where –
children.text: a request is made to the Registrar to do so within three months of public notice of the name being given under section 5 (1) (d) and section 9 (2) by another company or by a registered overseas company, where –

children.raw_text: (i) the name of the first mentioned company is so similar to the name of the requesting company that it is likely to cause confusion; and
children.text: the name of the first mentioned company is so similar to the name of the requesting company that it is likely to cause confusion; and

children.raw_text: (ii) the requesting company was registered with its current name before the first mentioned company was registered with the name objected to; or”.
children.text: the requesting company was registered with its current name before the first mentioned company was registered with the name objected to; or

body.heading: Amendment of section 10 of the principal enactment.

body.raw_text: 5. In the event of any inconsistency between the Sinhala and Tamil texts of this Act, the Sinhala text shall prevail.
body.text: In the event of any inconsistency between the Sinhala and Tamil texts of this Act, the Sinhala text shall prevail.
body.heading: Sinhala text to prevail in case of inconsistency.
